   1 class_name RoomCatalog extends RefCounted
   2 
   3 const ROOM_PATHS: Dictionary = {
   4 	"grand_lobby": "res://data/rooms/grand_lobby.json",
   5 	"card_banquet_gallery": "res://data/rooms/card_banquet_gallery.json",
   6 	"roulette_clocktower": "res://data/rooms/roulette_clocktower.json",
   7 	"quiet_save_room": "res://data/rooms/quiet_save_room.json",
   8 	"house_throne": "res://data/rooms/house_throne.json"
   9 }
  10 var last_error: String = ""
  11 
  12 func load_room(room_id: String, resources: ResourceCatalog) -> Dictionary:
  13 	if not ROOM_PATHS.has(room_id):
  14 		last_error = "Unknown room: " + room_id
  15 		return {}
  16 	var parser := JSON.new()
  17 	if parser.parse(FileAccess.get_file_as_string(ROOM_PATHS[room_id])) != OK:
  18 		last_error = "Corrupt room JSON: " + room_id
  19 		return {}
  20 	var parsed: Variant = parser.data
  21 	if not parsed is Dictionary or not validate_room(parsed, resources):
  22 		if last_error.is_empty():
  23 			last_error = "Room JSON is not an object: " + room_id
  24 		return {}
  25 	return parsed
  26 
  27 func validate_room(room: Dictionary, resources: ResourceCatalog) -> bool:
  28 	last_error = ""
  29 	var version: Variant = room.get("version")
  30 	if not (version is int or version is float) or version != 1 or not ROOM_PATHS.has(room.get("id", "")) or not room.get("name") is String or room.name.is_empty():
  31 		return _reject("Invalid room identity/version")
  32 	if not _vector(room.get("bounds"), 4) or room.bounds[2] <= 0 or room.bounds[3] <= 0:
  33 		return _reject("Invalid room bounds")
  34 	if not resources.has_asset(room.get("background", "")):
  35 		return _reject("Unknown room background")
  36 	if not _vector(room.get("light"), 4):
  37 		return _reject("Invalid room light")
  38 	for value in room.light:
  39 		if value < 0 or value > 1:
  40 			return _reject("Light outside 0..1")
  41 	if not room.get("spawns") is Dictionary or not room.spawns.has("start"):
  42 		return _reject("Missing start spawn")
  43 	for value in room.spawns.values():
  44 		if not _vector(value, 2):
  45 			return _reject("Invalid spawn position")
  46 	var ids: Dictionary = {}
  47 	for collection in ["platforms", "props", "doors"]:
  48 		if not room.get(collection) is Array:
  49 			return _reject("Missing room array: " + collection)
  50 		for record in room[collection]:
  51 			if not record is Dictionary or not record.get("id") is String or record.id.is_empty() or ids.has(record.id):
  52 				return _reject("Missing or duplicate room record id")
  53 			ids[record.id] = true
  54 			if collection == "platforms":
  55 				if not _vector(record.get("rect"), 4) or record.rect[2] < 320 or int(record.rect[2]) % 160 != 0 or record.rect[3] <= 0:
  56 					return _reject("Invalid platform rectangle or segment width")
  57 			else:
  58 				if not _vector(record.get("position"), 2):
  59 					return _reject("Invalid object position")
  60 				if collection == "props" and (not resources.has_asset(record.get("asset_id", "")) or not _vector(record.get("size"), 2) or record.size[0] <= 0 or record.size[1] <= 0):
  61 					return _reject("Invalid prop asset or size")
  62 				if collection == "doors" and (not record.get("target_room") is String or not record.get("target_spawn") is String or not record.get("prompt") is String or record.target_room.is_empty() or record.target_spawn.is_empty()):
  63 					return _reject("Invalid door destination")
  64 	for spawn in room.spawns.values():
  65 		if not _safe_spawn(spawn, room):
  66 			return _reject("Spawn has no safe standing surface")
  67 	if not room.get("enemies", []) is Array:
  68 		return _reject("Invalid enemy array")
  69 	for enemy in room.get("enemies", []):
  70 		if not enemy is Dictionary or not enemy.get("kind", "") in ["melee", "ranged", "flying"] or not _vector(enemy.get("position"), 2):
  71 			return _reject("Invalid enemy record")
  72 		if not enemy.get("id") is String or enemy.id.is_empty() or ids.has(enemy.id):
  73 			return _reject("Missing or duplicate enemy id")
  74 		ids[enemy.id] = true
  75 	for kind in ["relic", "checkpoint", "boss"]:
  76 		var record: Variant = room.get(kind)
  77 		if record == null:
  78 			continue
  79 		if not record is Dictionary or not _vector(record.get("position"), 2) or not record.get("id") is String or record.id.is_empty() or ids.has(record.id):
  80 			return _reject("Invalid interaction/boss record")
  81 		ids[record.id] = true
  82 		if kind != "boss" and not record.get("prompt") is String:
  83 			return _reject("Missing interaction prompt")
  84 		if kind == "relic" and (room.id != "roulette_clocktower" or record.id != "moonstep"):
  85 			return _reject("Invalid relic location")
  86 		if kind == "checkpoint" and (room.id != "quiet_save_room" or not room.spawns.has(record.get("spawn_id", ""))):
  87 			return _reject("Invalid checkpoint spawn")
  88 		if kind == "boss":
  89 			if room.id != "house_throne" or record.id != "royal_dealer" or not _vector(record.get("arena"), 4):
  90 				return _reject("Invalid boss arena")
  91 			var area := Rect2(record.arena[0], record.arena[1], record.arena[2], record.arena[3])
  92 			var bounds := Rect2(room.bounds[0], room.bounds[1], room.bounds[2], room.bounds[3])
  93 			if not bounds.encloses(area) or not area.has_area():
  94 				return _reject("Boss arena outside room")
  95 	return true

  97 func validate_graph(resources: ResourceCatalog) -> bool:
  98 	var catalog: Dictionary = {}
  99 	for room_id in ROOM_PATHS:
 100 		var room: Dictionary = load_room(room_id, resources)
 101 		if room.is_empty():
 102 			return false
 103 		catalog[room_id] = room
 104 	for room in catalog.values():
 105 		for door in room.doors:
 106 			if not catalog.has(door.target_room) or not catalog[door.target_room].spawns.has(door.target_spawn):
 107 				return _reject("Dangling door destination: " + room.id + "/" + door.id)
 108 	var reached: Array[String] = ["grand_lobby"]
 109 	var index: int = 0
 110 	while index < reached.size():
 111 		for door in catalog[reached[index]].doors:
 112 			if not door.target_room in reached:
 113 				reached.append(door.target_room)
 114 		index += 1
 115 	return true if reached.size() == ROOM_PATHS.size() else _reject("Disconnected room graph")
 116 
 117 func _safe_spawn(value: Array, room: Dictionary) -> bool:
 118 	var bounds := Rect2(room.bounds[0], room.bounds[1], room.bounds[2], room.bounds[3])
 119 	var feet := Vector2(value[0], value[1])
 120 	if not bounds.has_point(feet) or feet.y - 96 < bounds.position.y:
 121 		return false
 122 	var supported: bool = false
 123 	var actor := Rect2(feet - Vector2(20, 96), Vector2(40, 95))
 124 	for platform in room.platforms:
 125 		var r: Array = platform.rect
 126 		if absf(feet.y - r[1]) < 0.1 and feet.x - 24 >= r[0] and feet.x + 24 <= r[0] + r[2]:
 127 			supported = true
 128 		if actor.intersects(Rect2(r[0], r[1], r[2], r[3])):
 129 			return false
 130 	return supported
 131 
 132 func _vector(value: Variant, count: int) -> bool:
 133 	if not value is Array or value.size() != count:
 134 		return false
 135 	for part in value:
 136 		if not (part is int or part is float) or not is_finite(float(part)):
 137 			return false
 138 	return true
 139 
 140 func _reject(message: String) -> bool:
 141 	last_error = message
 142 	return false
